infrastructure.name: Ono-Sendai Warm-Standby Host — Provision Ono-Sendai for full JasonOS failover during a declared continuity event
infrastructure.notes: Make Ono-Sendai a pre-provisioned warm standby JasonOS can fully migrate to during a declared continuity event (JasonOS Sandbox unavailable/impaired) and migrate back. Authorized by PCR-BC-003 (approved 2026-06-25; policy layer enacted). Exceptional-use only — NOT regular operations. Ready to pull (Backlog); Security Steward review is a hard gate before first reliance. Single-primary: JasonOS Sandbox is OFF for the migration window. Scope: host provisioning, host-local config under version control, a Mode 3 promote/demote procedure, Security Steward review, and a failover drill.

infrastructure.name: KB Drive Backup — Snapshot → One-Way Folder-Tree Mirror (browsable + relocation-pullable)
infrastructure.notes: Convert the INI-075 knowledge backup runner output from a dated concatenated CONFIDENTIAL snapshot to a ONE-WAY folder-tree mirror in the CONFIDENTIAL Drive folder, so the KB is browsable on Drive web and pullable intact during a relocation (Mode 1) with no second-account Drive sync app. One-way only — preserves backup integrity; two-way is explicitly rejected. Confidentiality rides the existing folder ACL. Enables the relocation procedure's KB-access target; resolves a PCR-BC-002 follow-on. Open design decision at kickoff: point-in-time history + deletion handling.
